jobs.items: Add a small squat futuristic insulated drink dispenser on the left, two simple matte ceramic mugs in muted gray and olive on a shallow tray near it, and a small closed tea tin. Leave the right half of the worktop empty.
jobs.prompt: Edit the attached counter to make ONE dressed variation. Preserve its counter silhouette, cabinet structure, handles, colors, top geometry, painted texture, overhead/cutaway perspective and proportions as closely as possible. Add a small squat futuristic insulated drink dispenser on the left, two simple matte ceramic mugs in muted gray and olive on a shallow tray near it, and a small closed tea tin. Leave the right half of the worktop empty. All items must rest convincingly on the top with matching perspective and restrained matte hand-painted finish. Futuristic underwater-base everyday objects, broad readable shapes, no dense microdetail, shiny reflections, white piping, text, glow or vintage electronics. Keep all objects' physical footprints within the counter top and clear of the straight rear edge so the counter can still abut a wall. Preserve transparent background, add no wall or floor or cast shadow outside the counter. Entire counter and objects visible with margins. Target counter width 245 library pixels, so accessories must read simply at small size. Do not change the counter into a different design.

jobs.items: Add a low charcoal tool tray containing one broad wrench and a screwdriver on the left, two spare gray cylindrical couplings near the middle, and a small closed muted olive parts case on the right. Keep generous clear work surface between these sparse groups.
